units.source_text: 电文非常简单，只写了他因事故而死亡。

en.t: The telegram was very simple; it only said that he had died in an accident.

units.source_text: 后来才了解到详情是这样的：鹤川去世的头天晚上曾到浅草他的伯父家，喝了一些他不常喝的酒，

en.t: Only later did I learn the details: on the night before his death, Tsurukawa had gone to his uncle's house in Asakusa and drunk a little alcohol, which he was not used to,

units.source_text: 归途在车站附近被一辆突然从小胡同里驶出来的卡车撞倒在地，颅骨骨折，当场毙命。

en.t: and on his way home, near the station, he was knocked to the ground by a truck that suddenly came out of a narrow side street; his skull was fractured, and he died on the spot.

units.source_text: 全家人顿时束手无策，好不容易才想起应该给鹿苑寺发封电报时，已是事发后翌日的下午了。

en.t: His whole family was at once at a loss, and by the time they finally thought to send a telegram to Rokuonji, it was already the afternoon of the day after the accident.
